event_store_scope: one experiment run; retain and clear never share mutable state
native_model_audit: native-model-params-reference-1: keep each complete request in model, refer to its SHA256 from audit; legacy audits remain readable
native_source: archive-SHA keyed, verified immutable source cache; read-only source mounts may share hardlinks, mutable task memories never do
task_working_memory: remove only this task's live-state UUID after summary commit and exact checkpoint manifest verification; preserve failed or uncommitted state; GC failures cannot change scientific outcomes
archive_rule: archive the entire run, including event-store; verify every member before declaring sealed

required_guards: exact private-root containment; no reparse points
exclude all current roots and dependencies
driver exit 0; exclusive run ownership lock available
archive SHA/size matches existing complete local verification
every removed raw file covered by retained archive at the same size
write a separate offload receipt; never rewrite original audit or passed receipt

completed_with_original_driver_verified_.removable_server_duplicates: only unpacked files explicitly present in the retained sealed archive manifest at the same size
completed_with_original_driver_verified_.preserve: keep the complete server evidence.zip, result, strict audit, original driver receipts, public projections, memory and all unique unarchived data
required_guards: original archive.contents_verified true; archive file present at recorded size; exit 0
exclusive old run ownership lock available and no running scheduled action references root
exclude every current experiment root and common native/runtime dependencies
immutable original archive/result/passed receipts; separate removal manifest and receipt

cold_history_reclamation.archived_checkpoints: offload unpacked memory-after only after matching the unchanged archived summary and complete snapshot manifest; retain a restoration pointer including directory metadata
cold_history_reclamation.duplicate_working_memory: remove only if the complete content and metadata match a preserved checkpoint; retain unique or unproven copies
cold_history_reclamation.rebuildable_native_cache: evict only files matching the retained original native archive by SHA256; retain modified or unique source files and record archive member mappings
cold_history_reclamation.unique_unarchived_payloads: preserve logical bytes; optional lossless filesystem compression for inactive cold traces, excluding current roots and shared dependencies

existing_frozen_cohorts: no hot patch, no restart, no new model call; leave their storage format unchanged
